description: Compiled right-hand-side conformance. Every binding's engine must reproduce the reference INTERPRETER's f(u, p, t) at fixed probe states, within the tolerance of the fixture's class. Agreement is numerical; nothing here inspects an emitted program. A model a compiled engine cannot lower completely is a hard error in that binding, recorded as a NAMED EXCLUSION in the report — never a pass and never a silent skip. Precision-changing fixtures are excluded until both emitters lower them (see `excluded`). Probe states and analytic_rhs anchors are generated by scripts/gen_compiled_rhs_manifest.py; see tests/conformance/compiled_rhs/README.md for the generator's seed and rules.
